features.normalization: divide s/g/d by their office1-1 build medians recorded in the pilot audit; spatial proxies remain in native [0,1] coordinates

challenger_identity.label: literature-inspired query spatial-distribution proxy
challenger_identity.not_label: Ferranti et al. confidence model reproduction
challenger_identity.reason: Exact query/database neighborhood coverage, trained logistic model, and independent pose-correctness training groups are unavailable.

analysis.quartile_contrast: ceil(25% of available rows), lowest versus highest feature values with input-index tie break
analysis.time_confound: Spearman rho between each feature/outcome and input_index
analysis.missing_policy: same-frame complete-case per feature/outcome; report every denominator

decision_boundary.permitted: Assess whether the challenger is numerically executable and whether current development data show an obvious redundancy or contradiction.
decision_boundary.prohibited: Claim superiority, incremental predictive value, statistical significance, generalization, or detector performance from one contiguous run.
decision_boundary.negative_result: If the spatial challenger matches or exceeds the three-axis summaries, retain that result and narrow novelty; do not tune a fusion.
